How it works

  1. 1

    Enter your URL or select another supported QR type, then check the preview with a phone.

  2. 2

    For PNG, set Download size to 2048 × 2048 px and click Download PNG. For vector artwork, click Download SVG.

  3. 3

    Place the file with clear space around it, print a sample, and scan the physical print before producing copies.

Keep dark code modules on a light background with enough contrast for phone cameras.
Leave a quiet margin around the QR code; avoid placing text or graphics against its edges.
Use a size suited to the expected viewing distance and avoid stretching the code unevenly.
If the destination or encoded details change, regenerate and replace the printed static code.

Frequently asked questions

What is the largest PNG download option?

Choose 2048 × 2048 px in the Download size menu above.

Should I use PNG or SVG for print?

Both can work. Use the 2048px PNG at an appropriate physical size, or SVG when the design needs a scalable vector file.
